_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - verify every number against the vendor's current price list before relying on it. Copied 2026-11-03 from Anthropic's first-party API list prices, per million tokens. input and output are list prices; cache_read is the listed rate for claude-opus-5-5 and claude-sonnet-5-5 and 0.1x input for claude-opus-5; cache_write is the 5-minute cache write at 1.25x input and cache_write_1h the one-hour cache write at 2x input. cache_write_1h is optional: without it one-hour writes are priced at cache_write (docs/adr/0031). Models with tiered or context-dependent pricing are left out, and so are Codex/OpenAI models: add those from the vendor's price list, with 0 for a kind it does not charge. Every model needs the four rates input, output, cache_read and cache_write. A key ending in * matches every model id that starts with the rest. Used by ccd serve --usage-prices (docs/adr/0022); the result is shown as an estimate, never as spent.
